from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-8f61f5cf.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-length color-4 lines divide the canvas into repeated panels.
    row_divs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_divs + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_divs + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if tile and tile[0]:
                panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, tile))
    # The only non-background panel is the pattern to repeat.
    seed = next((p for p in panels if any(v != 4 for row in p[4] for v in row) and
                 len({v for row in p[4] for v in row}) > 1), None)
    if seed is None:
        seed = next(p for p in panels if any(v != 4 for row in p[4] for v in row))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1, tile = seed
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1, _ in panels:
        if r1-r0 == sr1-sr0 and c1-c0 == sc1-sc0:
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = tile[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
